crossRefs.note: He fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of food, oil and wine.
He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
When Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of…

people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
translations.bsb: He stationed troops in every fortified city of Judah and put garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
translations.kjv: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
translations.asv: And he placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
